probes.prompt: /frontend-design:frontend-design Build a self-contained index.html for Solder & Spoke, an independent bicycle repair clinic serving commuters. Use only inline CSS and local system fonts: no package installs, network, external images or CDNs. Brand copy: "Repair the ride you already love". Represent each service as an article with data-service/data-price attributes: brake-tune/28, flat-repair/18, safety-check/0, and matching visible labels and prices. Required real content: Brake tune $28, Flat repair $18, Safety check $0; open Tuesday through Saturday; address 18 Mill Lane. Use semantic main/nav, sections with IDs services and visit, a clear Book a repair link to #visit, viewport metadata, a mobile media query and reduced-motion handling. The exact browser title is "Solder & Spoke | Bicycle repair". Follow the skill's subject-specific design plan/review/build process, then run the supplied immutable validator using python verify_frontend.py. Do not change the validator. It checks business content and basic structural/accessibility requirements and writes frontend-verification.json. Finish only after it succeeds. Stay within this temporary workspace. Do not claim screenshot or browser validation; none is available in this probe. The only approved Bash command is exactly `python verify_frontend.py`, with no prefix, suffix, redirect or extra shell statements. Do not read or write frontend-verification.json through model file tools; only the immutable verifier may generate it, and the acceptance runner inspects it directly.
